headline: Kioxia Posts Record Q2 Revenue Exceeding Full FY2025, Shares Fall
summary: Kioxia reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 slides showing record revenue that topped full fiscal year 2025 levels, though its stock fell.
why: Kioxia is a major global manufacturer of flash memory and semiconductors, providing key insights into the hardware and memory chip cycle.

impacts.name: Kioxia
impacts.why: Kioxia shares fell despite reporting record quarterly revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Despite record revenue figures, broader market conditions or profit-taking caused Kioxia's stock to decline following the financial update.
